searchText: Hi all, I was rather sure about the decisions regarding Shandong yesterday but I am not anymore. Do we want 1153 on Shandong? I am new to this ACD call process, but I think what we should at least do is to create a "decision sheet" of whatever is decided at the ACD ASAP, so we can all agree after the ACD whatever was discussed and focus on that (for instance, at this point, I do not exactly know how some of the EIP states changed - did they get CFId or not? - I should have taken better notes myself anyways, but it should still be at a central (... hah 😅 ) point such that we can all agree on these notes/decisions) There was no decision if 1153 should go into shandong. Perhaps we need a #shandong channel in the R&D discord and make the decision there? Figuring out testnets plans was on the agenda, but we didn't have time to discuss on the call, unfortunately. I'd use <#892088344438255616> (or this channel?) if we want to discuss it async in the meantime. yeah, that's fair - we used to do this in the past and have them as part of the transcripts. It felt a bit bureaucratic at times to do, and we eventually drop it, but we could fairly easily bring it back. For the last call, I believe the only "explicit" decision we made was to move 1153 to CFI. I usually try and post PRs up for these things right after and share them here, but I was travelling yesterday and <@383836935480803339> offered to open it but wasn't sure how to proceed, so was blocked on me. Another thing where we can perhaps improve is that because we do full transcripts for ACD, they usually take a few days to be uploaded/merged in the `/pm` repo. This means it might be easiest to separate a lightweight "decision summary" from a full transcript. V1 of this might just be posting a list of decisions in the discord here after the call? And then we can record them more permanently in the transcript?
